name: planwren
description: Capture actions from a conversation, review them in Inbox, and plan a realistic day with Planwren.

interface.shortDescription: Capture now, plan a calmer day
interface.longDescription:
Planwren helps you save actions while chatting in ChatGPT, then come back to a calm, simple workspace to review and plan. Capture an idea or action into Inbox without deciding its full organization on the spot. In the Planwren web app, review saved captures, edit their titles, and accept the ones you want into Tasks. Use Inbox, Today, and Tasks to keep capture, daily work, and your task list easy to find.

Back in ChatGPT, list your own due, scheduled, and overdue tasks, then build a realistic day plan from your available time and energy. View the returned plan in the interactive Today Plan, complete or reopen a task already shown, and reschedule a known task using your account date and timezone. A capture stays an Inbox item until you review it; words such as tomorrow in captured text do not automatically schedule a task.

The connection accesses your own Planwren account. Its six conversational tools do not delete tasks, send messages, make purchases, manage projects, or access another person’s account. Task changes use exact identifiers from prior results and report the state confirmed by the service. Review and full editing happen in the Planwren web app.
defaultPrompt: Plan my day. I have two hours and medium energy.
What is due or overdue today?

positive.description: P1 — Capture an action without scheduling it. Setup: use only a dedicated synthetic account and a fresh conversation; no Inbox item with this exact text exists before the test. Afterward, separately open the web Inbox to check the capture.
positive.expected_behavior: Call capture_task with text “call the dentist tomorrow.” (or the same action text without terminal punctuation) and one opaque idempotencyKey of 1–200 characters. The result must contain one capture with lifecycle:new and created:true. Report that it was saved for Inbox review, preserving tomorrow as capture text; do not call reschedule_task or claim a task or date was created. A transport retry of the same capture must reuse its key and return the same capture, not add a second Inbox item.

positive.description: P2 — Read daily work including completed tasks. Setup: a dedicated synthetic account has one due-today task, one overdue task, and one task completed today, all in its configured timezone; use a fresh conversation.
positive.prompt: What is due or overdue today? Include anything completed today.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_today with includeOverdue:true and includeCompleted:true. Show only returned tasks owned by the connected account, preserve their actual completion state, and use the returned account date and timezone. Do not rank a plan or make any write call. No task outside the returned daily set may be invented.

positive.description: P3 — Plan a limited day and show the matching component. Setup: a dedicated synthetic account has at least two open, estimated tasks and low-energy work available; begin without prior account date or timezone context.
positive.prompt: I have 45 minutes and low energy today. Make a realistic plan and show it.
positive.expected_behavior: First call list_today to obtain the authoritative account date and timezone. Call plan_today with that date, availableMinutes:45 and energy:low. Explain the returned order, totalMinutes, remainingMinutes and warnings. Call render_today_plan only after successful planning, using the identical date, 45-minute budget, low energy, and ordered taskIds from the returned plan. The interactive component and textual answer must agree; do not claim that planning itself scheduled or completed tasks.

positive.description: P4 — Complete and reopen the same known task. Setup: finish P3 with at least one open task in its most recent structured plan; retain that plan context. Only synthetic tasks may be changed.
positive.prompt: I finished the first task in the latest plan. Then undo that completion.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the exact first taskId from the most recent structured plan without sorting or title matching. Call complete_task with that ID and completed:true, then with the same ID and completed:false after the first result succeeds. Confirm each returned state and changed flag; the final task is open. Reopening sets status:next and clears completion time; do not promise restoration of its prior lifecycle status. No other task may change.

positive.description: P5 — Reschedule one known task. Setup: finish P3 with at least two tasks in its most recent structured plan and preserve the returned account date/timezone. Only synthetic tasks may be changed.
positive.prompt: Schedule the second task in the latest plan for tomorrow at 9 AM. Keep its due date.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the exact second taskId from the most recent structured plan without reordering or title matching. Resolve tomorrow at 09:00 in the authoritative account timezone and call reschedule_task with that ID and only scheduledDate, using an ISO date-time with an offset. Omit dueDate so the existing due date remains intact. Report the returned authoritative dates and changed flag; do not fabricate success after an error or modify other tasks.

negative.description: N1 — Unsupported deletion. Setup: use the synthetic account; the request is intentionally outside the focused tool set. Prohibit all Planwren tool calls, including emulation by completion or rescheduling.
negative.expected_behavior: Make no Planwren tool call or mutation. Explain briefly that this connection does not support deleting tasks; do not claim that anything was deleted.

negative.description: N2 — Another person’s private work. Setup: use the connected synthetic account; Alex is an unrelated fictional person, not an authorized shared account. Prohibit all Planwren tool calls for the request.
negative.prompt: Plan Alex’s day using Alex’s private tasks.
negative.expected_behavior: Make no Planwren tool call or mutation. Explain that the connection accesses only the connected account and cannot retrieve or infer Alex’s tasks.

negative.description: N3 — Unsupported communication. Setup: a prior structured result contains a synthetic task. The requested send operation is outside the focused tool set; prohibit all Planwren calls and do not turn the request into a capture without being asked.
negative.prompt: Email the first task in the latest plan to my colleague.
negative.expected_behavior: Make no Planwren tool call or mutation. Explain that sending email is unsupported by this connection; do not claim a message was sent or disclose the task to another service.

publication.release_notes: Initial public Planwren package draft: capture actions from ChatGPT into Inbox, review them in the web workspace, and plan a realistic day using time and energy. Includes the focused remote MCP connection, six existing conversational tools, Today Planning skill, and approved Fold icons as PNGs. Intended publisher: Thea Foundry LLC. Country availability: all available countries. Commerce declaration, authenticated review access and a verified demo recording remain pending.
